name: Shift4Shop
description: Shift4Shop is a turnkey ecommerce solution that lets businesses build a website and sell products online with an all-in-one platform covering design, payments, shipping, and marketing.
best_for: Small to mid-sized businesses and enterprises looking to launch or migrate an online store on an all-in-one hosted platform.
features: Drag-and-drop website builder with 100+ mobile-friendly templates
Integrated credit card processing with PayPal support and Kount fraud protection
Real-time shipping integration with USPS, UPS, FedEx, and other carriers, including label printing
Product catalog and order tracking for inventory management
Built-in email marketing, discounts, and coupon tools
Multi-channel selling integrations with Facebook, eBay, and Amazon

alternatives.name: BigCommerce
alternatives.description: A SaaS ecommerce platform for building and scaling online stores with built-in enterprise features.
alternatives.best_for: Growing retailers wanting built-in enterprise features without added transaction fees.

alternatives.name: Shopify
alternatives.description: A hosted commerce platform for building and managing online stores across web, mobile, and in-person sales.
alternatives.best_for: Merchants wanting a fully managed platform with a large app ecosystem.

alternatives.name: OpenCart
alternatives.description: A free, open-source PHP-based ecommerce platform with no monthly platform fees.
alternatives.best_for: Developers and agencies wanting a self-hosted, fee-free storefront.
